name: Nippon Denko Co., Ltd.
summary: Nippon Denko Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the ferroalloys, functional materials, incineration ash resource recovery, aqua solutions, and electric power businesses in Japan. The company offers ferroalloys products, including high and low carbon ferromanganese, silomanganese, and ferrosilicon; warehousing, port cargo handling, and functional materials, such as zirconium and boron oxide, metal hydride and boron alloys, storage alloys, manganese inorganic chemical products, and cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries.
